Kenya's digital-ID transparency gap now has a contradiction attached: the newest numbers on record (90,038 Maisha Numbers across four counties in an Aug 2025 progress report; 1.7M Maisha Cards printed) do not reconcile with the 13M 'holders' used since May 2024. A future 'digital-ID reporting transparency' indicator would capture this directly.

pillar_commentary: Findex 2025 shows 84% of Nigerian adults own a phone, 63% hold an account and 54% make digital payments. The distance between account ownership and use, and Nigeria's gap to Kenya (90% accounts) and South Africa (81%), is an inclusion signal that FIN-01 as defined cannot show.

With 4.4M adults previously reported as holding no ID at all, people outside the banking network risk being served last.
